description: This file contains a function 'render' responsible for generating visual representations (chart outputs) in various formats (PNG, PDF, SVG) using the Cairo graphics library. It chooses the appropriate surface based on the desired format, computes extents, and renders the trace data onto the surface, then saves it to a file. It also handles unknown formats gracefully.

methods.name: render(writer, trace, app_options, filename)
methods.description: Generates a chart in specified format (png, pdf, svg) from trace data and writes it to a file, with error handling for unknown formats.
